title: Predicting Annotation Difficulty to Improve Task Routing and Model Performance for Biomedical Information Extraction
answer_rationale: The documents refer to 'instances' in the context of biomedical information extraction (IE) tasks, where instances are defined as sentences containing spans (e.g., Population, Intervention, Outcome) that are annotated or predicted. The term 'instance' is used interchangeably with 'sentence' in the context of difficulty prediction, but the actual annotation units (i.e., the extracted spans) are referred to as IE tuples. For example, Text 2 mentions 'predicted spans' as proxy ground truth annotations, and Text 6 refers to 'instances' as the units being routed or weighted based on difficulty, which are sentences containing spans — i.e., IE tuples.
